summary: Chunk 1 of Sū 20 (30 units) reviewed word by word. Errors: 0; minor: 17; no regrouping suggested (the 'GROUPING:' notes in 23-25 are reworded, since the verse grouping is correct). All 20 text_flags checked: every one has evidence inside the chunk or from grammar; none dropped. 15 are firm typos (śleṣam-, vātra-, abhyaṇga, palāśāīnāṃ, aprisaṃ-, pitasya, apakarśati, śelṣma-, sht, karṃaṇaḥ, mādhuraya, karmāṇiḥ, tīkṣn/rūksāi, āpadyane, and śleṣam in 3); the 5 'possible' ones are kept as possible: gudabhrāṃśa (pādabhraṃśa in the same list), vakṣau- x2 (kept, reasoning corrected to stem vakṣas, hiatus), vareṇa->varṇa (unit 12; vareṇa cannot stand inside the compound, varṇa in unit 15), urogatā->urogatam (unit 19; urogatā agrees with nothing; uraḥ is Kapha's chief site in unit 8), anubandhaṃśca->anubandhaśca (unit 23; ṃś is irregular sandhi). Counts verified by the reviewer: P3 has 81 nouns in 80 comma-separated items (śiroruk ca keśabhūmisphuṭanaṃ ca without comma) for 'eighty'; unit 14 has 40 items once the bracketed (aṅgasvedaśca) and (māṃsadāhaśca) are removed (kakṣā(kṣyā) is one item); unit 17 has 21 items for 'twenty' (prati(vi)caya is one item). Bracketed variants are handled consistently: split as printed, kept out of count and translation, unbracketed reading used in 17. kotha (th, putrefaction) in 15 is a real word distinct from koṭha (rash) in 14 and is rightly not corrected; kleda is rendered 'moistness', not putrefaction. kevalam = 'entire/whole' as an adjective in 13 and 16 (twice) is consistent and grammatical. mukha = gateway accepted. No notes cite commentators, other editions or memory; no modern identifications remain after the pakṣavadha fix. Glossary extended.
